favourite.heading: Why Texas Tech can pull away
bullets: Texas Tech is the better football team by 17.1 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 55% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (-17.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Texas Tech by 3.2 points: ball control vs front disruption (-3.2 pts).
Talent: Texas Tech 70.3 (#1 of 137) vs Colorado 37.0 (#127 of 137) — 126 places on the national board.
Offense: Texas Tech 64.2 (#6 of 137) vs Colorado 41.7 (#119 of 137) — 113 places on the national board.
QB room: Texas Tech 60.7 (#24 of 137) vs Colorado 52.8 (#132 of 137) — 108 places on the national board.

underdog.heading: Why Colorado can keep it close
bullets: Playing at Colorado is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
The outcome range is 14.8 points wide at one sigma — p10 -38.2 to p90 +3.8 for Colorado, so a projection of -16.2 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 1%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
